spec: W2-03 inspection data flow + state machine
source: mentor answer #10 (sheet 'Phan hoi cau hoi', workbook reviewed 2026-09-30)
implementation_under_test: docs/Tuan_2/W2-04/reference_api.py (lab reference server, stub / fake KServe backend)

transitions.durable_write: INSERT row: request_id, fingerprint, product_id, input_sha256, trace_id, pin_json (recipe+model+threshold)

transitions.event: waited in queue longer than queue_timeout_s
backend returned a score; pinned threshold applied
transitions.durable_write: UPDATE state, decision, score, finished_at (before any consumer can read it)

transitions.event: found at startup after crash/restart (was still queued)
transitions.durable_write: UPDATE state, reason, finished_at during startup scan, before listeners open

transitions.event: found at startup after crash/restart (inference had started)
transitions.durable_write: UPDATE state, reason, finished_at during startup scan, before listeners open

invariants.rule: A result is returned only under its own request_id and carries the product_id, input_sha256 and pinned recipe/model of that request
One request_id maps to exactly one record; same id + other payload is rejected with 409 and the old record is untouched
A replay returns the stored record; it is never re-scored with a newer recipe/model
Terminal states never change: a late backend result is logged and ignored
decision is non-null only when state=COMPLETED
After a crash every admitted request is in exactly one terminal state and unfinished ones are identifiable by request_id, by product_id and in the ledger
The platform never re-runs inference by itself after a crash
The active recipe/model survives a crash; requests after restart are pinned to it

gaps.gap: Ledger UPDATE has no compare-and-set guard (WHERE state=<from>); terminal immutability relies on the single worker
KServe adapter does not compare the response id with request_id (defence against a mismatched backend response)
captured_at is part of the fingerprint but is not stored as a column nor returned in the result
No API to list requests by state/time window (only by product_id); operators must query the ledger
The original image is not stored (only input_sha256); image retention rules cannot be exercised yet

retention.class: image, decision NG / REVIEW / technical state

retention.proposal: 14 days and 10 GiB cap, whichever first
equal to ledger online retention (90 days)

mvp_only_note: Section 8b: implemented and tested only in mvp/ (TestCancellation, real-stack session P4/P5); not observable on the W2-04 reference server
